prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-19):
| Return 3m            | +17.0% |
| Return 1m            | +4.6% |
| Return 1w            | +4.5% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 22% |
| Last close           | 205.41 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown persistent up-momentum with +4.6% in 1 month and +17% over 3 months, supported by a solid 1-week gain (+4.5%) and a stable volatility around 22% on 21 days. Last close near recent range completion suggests continued upside potential, with a favorable risk-reward given the trend over multiple horizons.

DECISION: BUY
